notes.title: Argo is going free!
notes.notes: [p]It's already been almost two years since Argo was released on Steam. Time really does fly fast! To celebrate we decided that it was time to follow suit with our other two small games, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2302870/Class_Reunion_Chat_Room/"]Class Reunion Chat Room[/url] and [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3346760/Whisperstring/"]Whisperstring[/url], and make Argo free to play. The price change needs to be approved before it goes live but we wanted to warn you ahead of time. We hope that more people get the opportunity to enjoy the game this way. Keep your eyes peeled for future releases![/p][p][/p][p]Team RocRac[/p]
